summary: We are seeking a Manual Test Engineer with 2+ years of experience in the Banking and Financial Services domain. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in testing Internet Banking, Payments, Finacle, LOS, or LMS applications, with a strong understanding of manual testing processes and banking workflows.
responsibilities: Analyze business and functional requirements related to banking applications
Design, review, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
Perform Functional, Regression, Integration, and UAT testing
Validate Internet Banking and Payment workflows
Ensure data accuracy and compliance with banking standards
Log, track, and manage defects using defect tracking tools
Work closely with Business Analysts, Developers, and Product teams
Prepare test execution reports and provide daily/weekly status updates
required_skills: 2+ years of experience in Manual Testing
Strong experience in Banking domain testing
Hands-on exposure to one or more of the following: Internet Banking, Payments systems, Finacle, LOS (Loan Origination System), LMS (Loan Management System)
Experience in test case creation and defect life cycle
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, ALM, etc.)
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of SQL for basic data validation
benefits: Opportunity to work on critical banking applications
Career development opportunities in BFSI domain
